temperaments.about: How a monster meets a company that comes where it lives, when its species does not say (an animal without its own temperament has none): beasts and elementals hold their ground, the dead and demons fall on the living, aberrations lie in wait, constructs keep their posts, dragons name a price, the fey slip away, celestials defend.

about: Species: kinds of creature statted by their own nature rather than by an adventuring class. type is the creature classification; traits are nature traits that carry mechanics. statistics give the natural weapon and armour (Orsino weapon and armour entries), the hit die and a fixed or rolled stat line. A variant names its base species with variantOf and overrides only the fields it declares. A species creature has no class.

wisp.name: Wisp
wisp.description: A drifting mote of light that answers a summoner's call.

wolf.name: Wolf
wolf.description: A grey wolf of the uplands: a pack hunter with a rending bite.

source.notes: Orsino's wolf stat line (base 3 + kind) is not used; Kyr wolves roll their attributes.

frost_wolf.name: Frost-altered wolf
frost_wolf.description: A living wolf altered by an old winter shrine: a freezing bite and a howl that stops the heart.

boar.name: Marsh boar
boar.description: A territorial animal along reed margins.

source.notes: Orsino's boar: tusks and hide. Kyr rolls its attributes and gives it the Kyr rending bite.

dog.name: Dog
dog.description: A working dog of a farm, a drove or an inn: it knows people, and keeps an eye on what is theirs.

source.notes: Orsino's hound (as the feral cave hound has it), kept: the same bite and fur, tame, without the rending bite.

cat.name: Cat
cat.description: A cat about the house: it keeps the mice down and goes where it likes.

source.notes: A Kyr domestic animal; Orsino has none.

horse.name: Horse
horse.description: A horse broken to saddle or to the cart.

source.notes: A Kyr domestic animal; Orsino's horse is a wonder's form, not a beast.

sheep.name: Sheep
sheep.description: A sheep of the hill flocks, in its heavy coat.

source.notes: A Kyr domestic animal.

hen.name: Hen
hen.description: A hen scratching about a yard.

source.notes: A Kyr domestic animal.

pig.name: Pig
pig.description: A pig in its sty, or rooting in the wood under the swineherd's eye.

source.notes: A Kyr domestic animal.

cow.name: Cow
cow.description: A milk cow, slow and certain.

source.notes: A Kyr domestic animal.

cave_hound.name: Feral cave hound
cave_hound.description: A scavenging dog descended from abandoned working animals.

source.notes: Orsino's hound: bite and fur. Feral, with the Kyr rending bite.

revenant.name: Revenant
revenant.description: A barrow's dead warden, risen to drain the living and lull them to sleep.

source.notes: Orsino undead monster class: claws, cloth, curse, fear and life drain. It does not carry Orsino's undead trait; its resistances are Kyr's.

bronze_construct.name: Funerary bronze construct
bronze_construct.description: A bounded guardian of registered burials.

source.notes: Kyr creature of the construct type. It does not carry Orsino's construct trait; its poison immunity and physical resistance are Kyr's.

dragon.name: Dragon
dragon.description: A great winged reptile: scaled, clawed, cunning and proud.

source.notes: Composed by OrsinoMonsters (Dragon type, wildtype aspect, mountain terrain, minor rank, level 1). Natural armour, three attacks a turn, maul and the gold hoard are not modelled.

red_dragon.name: Red dragon
red_dragon.description: Its crimson scales shimmer like molten lava.

source.notes: The red colour gives the fire breath; Kyr keeps the bite for when the breath is spent.

golem.name: Golem
golem.description: A body of clay or metal, shaped and set to work by a maker.

source.notes: Composed by OrsinoMonsters (construct class, Golem type, wildtype aspect, cave terrain, minor rank, level 1). Plate natural armour and the charge and hide abilities are not modelled. Its line grows three hit points a level above the first, as Orsino's monster template grows a line (34 at level 8): a fixed 13 made the Stone-Singers' Unsung, a keeper of level 8, as easy to fell as a ghoul.

iron_golem.name: Iron golem
iron_golem.description: A golem of riveted iron plates: slow, and very hard to break.

source.notes: The iron substance overlay (+1 Str, −3 Dex, +4 Con) applied by OrsinoMonsters before hit points, as in the template.

bear.name: Bear
bear.description: A powerful woodland omnivore, dangerous when its young or feeding ground are threatened.

source.notes: Uses the existing claws and fur profiles and executable Smash action. Kyr rolls its attributes; the Deem animal grammar composes the body.

cave_spider.name: Cave spider
cave_spider.description: A dog-sized spider that strings the dark with sticky lines and waits for something to blunder into them.

source.notes: Orsino's spider: bite and chitin. Kyr enlarges it to a cave hunter, rolls its attributes and gives it Orsino's venomous bite and ensnare.

bone_hound.name: Knitted bone hound
bone_hound.description: A hound-shape of grave bones wired together and moved by a necromancer's binding. It has no eyes and does not tire.

source.notes: Kyr's own: a necromancer's watchdog for Holt keep's bone store.

slump.name: Slump
slump.description: Clay that water has worked loose and set moving: slow, heavy, and hard to hurt with a blunt blow. It holds its ground, and falls back into mud when the water leaves it.

source.notes: Kyr's own: the Wet under the Long Man. Orsino's mud elemental is as quick as all its elementals (dexterity 19), which made a mass of wet clay nimbler than a cat and nearly impossible for a new company to strike.

great_snake.name: Great snake
great_snake.description: A snake grown old and huge in the dark on whatever comes to it, as long as a hall and as thick as a man.

source.notes: Kyr's own: Orsino's snake is an animal's fixed line, 3 hit points at any level, so the great snake that keeps a deep's first level would be great in name only.

great_centipede.name: Great centipede
great_centipede.description: A centipede as long as a man is tall, pale from the dark, that comes fast and bites.

source.notes: Kyr's own: Orsino's centipede is an animal's fixed line, 2 hit points at any level.

great_pike.name: Great pike
great_pike.description: A pike grown old and huge in cold deep water, long as a boat, that takes whatever falls in.

source.notes: Kyr's own: the Old Jack of Hollow Water.

antimagic_ward.name: Antimagic ward
antimagic_ward.description: A circle of cut stones that hums when magic is near, and silences it.

source.notes: A fighting object: in Kyr a creature of the construct type that takes its turn in a fight like any other, with Orsino's abilities and traits for it. It does not move or answer; where it stands is where it was put.

barrier.name: Barrier
barrier.description: A wall of force or of stone set across the way, which does nothing but stand there and be in it.

source.notes: A fighting object: in Kyr a creature of the construct type that takes its turn in a fight like any other, with Orsino's abilities and traits for it. It does not move or answer; where it stands is where it was put.

bomb.name: Bomb
bomb.description: A thing that ticks, and will not tick for long.

source.notes: A fighting object: in Kyr a creature of the construct type that takes its turn in a fight like any other, with Orsino's abilities and traits for it. It does not move or answer; where it stands is where it was put.

phylactery.name: Phylactery
phylactery.description: A small dark vessel that holds what keeps something from staying dead.

source.notes: A fighting object: in Kyr a creature of the construct type that takes its turn in a fight like any other, with Orsino's abilities and traits for it. It does not move or answer; where it stands is where it was put.

turret.name: Turret
turret.description: An engine of the makers that looses bolts at whatever moves in front of it.

source.notes: A fighting object: in Kyr a creature of the construct type that takes its turn in a fight like any other, with Orsino's abilities and traits for it. It does not move or answer; where it stands is where it was put.
